llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define and register a ProductDetails screen route in the stack navigator.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: ProductDetails is defined as ProductDetailsScreen and registered in the stack navigator under the key 'ProductDetails'.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must pass a title param when navigating from list to product details.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: navigation.navigate('ProductDetails', ...) only passes productId; no title param is included in either navigation call.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must handle missing productId with a deterministic fallback display instead of showing stale or undefined values.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: When productId does not match the known product, product is set to null and the UI renders 'Product not found' instead of undefined or stale data.
evidence: const product = productId === PRODUCT.id ? PRODUCT : null

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use useNavigation to get the navigation object.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useNavigation is imported from @react-navigation/native and called inside ProductsScreen to obtain the navigation object.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createNativeStackNavigator is called with a static config object, and createStaticNavigation(Stack) is used to produce the Navigation component rendered in App.
